subject: Optimize CorpusHome queries: fix N+1s, materialization, subqueries
message:
Optimize CorpusHome queries: fix N+1s, materialization, subqueries

Phase 1 (zero-risk):
- CountableConnection.resolve_total_count(): use .count() instead of
  materializing entire queryset into Python to extract PKs
- DocumentRelationship: add nested select_related for creator FKs
  (source_document__creator, target_document__creator, corpus__creator)
  to eliminate up to 3N extra queries
- CorpusType.resolve_description_revisions: add select_related("author")
  to avoid N+1 on revision author lookups
- Pass context=info.context to DocumentRelationshipQueryOptimizer to
  enable request-level caching of visible IDs

Phase 2 (medium-risk):
- DocumentRelationshipQueryOptimizer: return lazy QuerySet subqueries
  from _get_visible_document_ids/_get_visible_corpus_ids instead of
  materializing all visible IDs into Python sets. Avoids O(N) memory
  and lets the database use efficient SQL subqueries.
- Pre-compute DocumentRelationship permission flags (_can_read,
  _can_create, etc.) via queryset annotations. Add
  "documentrelationship" to the mixin's pre-computed model list to
  avoid silent AttributeError on non-existent guardian tables.

Phase 3:
- Add lightweight=True parameter to Document visible_to_user() to skip
  heavy prefetch_related (doc_annotations, rows, relationships, notes)
  for list/TOC queries that only need basic fields. Saves ~7 unnecessary
  DB queries per TOC request.

subject: Fix telemetry test failures from cross-thread DB transaction visibility
message:
Fix telemetry test failures from cross-thread DB transaction visibility

Two root causes:

1. AsyncTelemetryTestCase: Django TestCase wraps each test in an
   uncommitted transaction visible only to the current DB connection.
   sync_to_async runs record_event in a different thread with a
   different connection, so Installation.objects.get() fails.
   Fix: mock record_event directly since we're testing that arecord_event
   delegates correctly, not the full pipeline.

2. InstallationIdCacheTestCase: mock path "config.telemetry.Installation
   .objects.get" was wrong because Installation is imported locally
   inside _get_installation_id(), not as a module attribute.
   Fix: use patch.object(Installation.objects, "get", ...) which
   intercepts the call regardless of import path.

   For test_cache_works_across_async_calls, pre-populate the cache
   synchronously before async calls to avoid the cross-thread DB issue.

subject: Fix infinite approval loop by injecting native tool history on resume
message:
Fix infinite approval loop by injecting native tool history on resume

After a user approves a tool call, resume_with_approval was re-running
the full agent with a text continuation prompt. The LLM never saw the
tool result in native ToolCallPart/ToolReturnPart format, so it called
the same tool again, triggering another approval — infinite loop.

Fix: build proper pydantic-ai message history with ToolCallPart (the
LLM's original call) + ToolReturnPart (the execution result) and pass
it to _stream_core via message_history kwarg. The LLM now sees a
completed tool round-trip and produces a natural follow-up response.

Confirmed via database evidence: messages 6-10 in conversation 2 all
had pending_tool_call for update_corpus_description with empty content,
showing the LLM kept re-invoking the same tool after each approval.

subject: Remove dead model preloader pipeline from Docker builds
message:
Remove dead model preloader pipeline from Docker builds

The model preloaders (docling, easyocr, sentence-transformers) were
downloading ML models into the Django container that are no longer used
there — PDF parsing, OCR, and embeddings have all been migrated to
dedicated microservice containers (docling-parser, vector-embedder).

These unused dependencies were the direct cause of CI build failures
across all PRs since 2026-02-16: an upstream PyPI release created a
pip dependency resolution explosion (3+ hour backtracking timeout)
when resolving docling's ~25 transitive deps alongside all other
requirements.

Changes:
- Remove model_preloaders.txt from both Dockerfiles' pip wheel steps
- Remove sentence-transformers installation from both Dockerfiles
- Remove /models directory creation and model preloader script execution
- Fix local Dockerfile to selectively include only needed requirements
  (local.txt + subdirectory extras), excluding docs.txt and production.txt
  that were unnecessarily inflating the dependency resolution space
- Keep spacy model downloads (still used by TxtParser)

subject: Streamline agentic corpus action configuration
message:
Streamline agentic corpus action configuration

Replace the confusing two-prompt system (AgentConfiguration.system_instructions +
CorpusAction.agent_prompt) with a single task_instructions field and auto-generated
goal-oriented system prompts.

Key changes:

- Rename agent_prompt -> task_instructions on CorpusAction model. This is the single
  field users fill in to describe what the agent should do.

- Auto-generate structured system prompts in the task runner that include automation
  guardrails ("you MUST use tools"), execution context (trigger type, document/corpus
  metadata), and the user's task instructions. Agents can no longer produce
  conversational responses instead of calling tools.

- Inject document context (title, ID, current description, corpus info) into the
  system prompt so agents don't waste tool calls on basic metadata lookups.

- Make AgentConfiguration optional for agent actions. CorpusAction can now be created
  with just task_instructions -- no agent_config required. The DB constraint
  (valid_action_type_configuration) allows this lightweight path.

- Add default tool selection by trigger type. When no tools are specified, the system
  auto-selects trigger-appropriate defaults (document tools for add/edit, moderation
  tools for thread/message triggers).

- Update GraphQL API: taskInstructions replaces agentPrompt in Create/Update mutations.

- Update frontend: labels changed from "Agent Prompt" to "Task Instructions".

Migration 0041 renames the field and updates the DB constraint.

message:
Refetch active Apollo queries on auth change via onClearStore callback

All auth transitions (login, logout, token refresh) already call
client.clearStore() through the CacheManager. This adds a single
onClearStore callback in App.tsx that refetches every active observable
query once the clear completes, so mounted components automatically
receive data appropriate to the new auth context.

This is especially important for Auth0 popup login where the user stays
on the same page — previously, the page's queries would not refetch
after the cache was cleared.

subject: Add context guardrails and conversation compaction to prevent context overflow
message:
Add context guardrails and conversation compaction to prevent context overflow

Implement three complementary safeguards against LLM context window
overflow in long-running conversations and large document analysis:

1. Token estimation - fast heuristic counter (~3.5 chars/token) that
   intentionally over-estimates to trigger compaction conservatively.

2. Conversation compaction - when message history exceeds 75% of the
   model's context window, older messages are replaced by a concise
   summary while preserving recent turns (4-20 messages) verbatim.
   Supports pluggable summary functions for LLM-based summarization.

3. Tool output truncation - string outputs from tools are automatically
   capped at 50K characters at the PydanticAI wrapper level, with a
   notice directing the LLM to use range parameters.

Includes model context window registry for 20+ models (OpenAI,
Anthropic, Google), per-agent CompactionConfig on AgentConfig, and
30+ unit tests using SimpleTestCase for fast parallel execution.

Closes #898

message:
Fix injected params leaking into tool annotations sent to LLM

PydanticAIToolWrapper copied all __annotations__ from the original
function, including inject_params like document_id that were already

subject: Persist compaction bookmarks on Conversation for cheap subsequent reads
message:
Persist compaction bookmarks on Conversation for cheap subsequent reads

Instead of recomputing compaction from scratch on every
_get_message_history() call, the system now persists the result:

- Added compaction_summary (TextField) and
  compacted_before_message_id (BigIntegerField) to Conversation model
- get_conversation_messages() filters with id__gt when a bookmark
  exists, so old messages are never loaded from the DB
- _get_message_history() reads the stored summary and only runs a
  fresh compaction pass when the remaining messages still exceed the
  context window threshold
- persist_compaction() on CoreConversationManager writes the bookmark
  atomically via asave(update_fields=...)
- Summaries merge incrementally: each compaction appends to the
  existing summary rather than replacing it

This turns a per-call O(n) token estimation + summary generation into
a one-time write followed by cheap filtered reads.

subject: Fix system prompt silently dropped by using instructions= instead of system_prompt=
message:
Fix system prompt silently dropped by using instructions= instead of system_prompt=

In pydantic-ai 0.2.20, the system_prompt parameter is only included in
API requests when message_history is None. Since OpenContracts' chat()
persists a HUMAN message before calling run(), history is always
non-empty, causing the entire system prompt to be silently dropped.

Switch all three PydanticAIAgent creation sites to use instructions=
which is always attached to every ModelRequest regardless of history.

Also updates default model to gpt-4.1 and documents the pitfall in
both docs/architecture/llms/README.md and CLAUDE.md.

subject: Fix stale cache causing test_pipeline_settings failures in CI
message:
Fix stale cache causing test_pipeline_settings failures in CI

QuerySet.delete() bypasses model.delete() and doesn't invalidate the
PipelineSettings cache. During setUp(), user creation signals trigger
personal corpus creation which calls get_default_embedder_path(),
populating the cache with test.py defaults. The two @override_settings
tests then get stale cached values instead of creating fresh instances
with the overridden settings. Adding _invalidate_cache() after the
queryset delete ensures get_instance() hits the DB and picks up the
overridden Django settings.

subject: Add chunked document processing for large PDFs
message:
Add chunked document processing for large PDFs

Large documents (70+ pages) that exceed Cloud Run timeout and response
size limits now automatically split into page-range chunks for
independent parsing and reassembly.

New BaseChunkedParser abstract class extends BaseParser with:
- Automatic PDF splitting via pypdf with configurable thresholds
- Optional concurrent chunk dispatch via ThreadPoolExecutor
- Per-chunk retry with exponential back-off
- Correct reassembly of PAWLs page indices, annotation references,
  and parent-child relationships across chunk boundaries
- Post-reassembly hook for document-wide processing (image extraction)

DoclingParser now extends BaseChunkedParser. Documents below the
chunking threshold (default: 75 pages) are processed unchanged.
Configurable via PipelineSettings (DOCLING_MAX_PAGES_PER_CHUNK,
DOCLING_MIN_PAGES_FOR_CHUNKING, DOCLING_MAX_CONCURRENT_CHUNKS).

clicking the first source (the most common case) never produced a

(PDF.tsx line 217: `selectedSourceIndex === null`).

subject: Fix _check_tool_requires_approval for pydantic-ai 1.x
message:
Fix _check_tool_requires_approval for pydantic-ai 1.x

In pydantic-ai 1.x, Tool has a native requires_approval field that
defaults to False. The previous code checked tool_obj.requires_approval
before checking tool_obj.function.core_tool.requires_approval, so it
always returned False (the native default) instead of the custom
attribute set by our tool wrapper.

Reorder the checks so the wrapped function's core_tool.requires_approval
is checked first, falling back to the native field only if the function
attributes aren't present.

subject: Fix page label regression for first-page PDF token annotations
message:
Fix page label regression for first-page PDF token annotations

The `annotation.page > 0` condition hid page labels for PDF token
annotations on page 0 (the first page). Changed to
`(annotation instanceof ServerTokenAnnotation || annotation.page > 0)`
so PDF token annotations always show page labels (page is always
meaningful) while span annotations only show them when page > 0
(page=0 is the sentinel for "no page concept applies").

Also fixed test mock type inaccuracy (error: null → error: false) and
updated test expectations for the corrected behavior.

subject: Fix Django 5.2 test compatibility: ContentFile name + admin form
message:
Fix Django 5.2 test compatibility: ContentFile name + admin form

1. test_analyzers.py: Add name= to ContentFile passed directly to
   Document.objects.create(). Django 5.2's FileField.pre_save() now
   requires ContentFile to have a name attribute.

2. users/forms.py: Inherit UserCreationForm from AdminUserCreationForm
   instead of plain UserCreationForm. Django 5.2's UserAdmin.add_fieldsets

subject: Add worker document upload system for external distributed workers
message:
Add worker document upload system for external distributed workers

Implements a complete system for external document-processing workers to
upload fully ingested, annotated, and embedded documents to target corpora
via REST API.

Key components:
- WorkerAccount model: service accounts with auto-created Django Users
- CorpusAccessToken: corpus-scoped tokens with expiry and rate limiting
- WorkerTokenAuthentication: DRF auth backend for WorkerKey headers
- REST API: POST /api/worker-uploads/documents/ (multipart upload),
  GET status/list endpoints
- WorkerDocumentUploadMetadataType: extends V2 format with embeddings
- Database-backed staging table (WorkerDocumentUpload) to avoid Redis
  saturation at high volumes
- Batch processor Celery task using SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for
  concurrent drain without conflicts
- Dedicated 'worker_uploads' Celery queue to preserve default queue
  capacity for regular user operations
- GraphQL mutations for managing worker accounts and tokens (superuser)
- Documents owned by corpus creator, not service account

fresh set for the new content, leaving parsed structural annotations
orphaned.

is unchanged. When content changes, it is set to None so the parser
creates a proper StructuralAnnotationSet during ingestion.

message:
Optimize version resolvers with subquery pattern and lightweight visibility

  doc IDs with a DB-level subquery (document__in=visible_version_docs).
  Pushes permission filtering into the database, eliminating one round-trip
  and the Python-side ID comparison loop.

  check into a single query via document__in subquery, removing the
  separate Document.objects.filter().visible_to_user().exists() call.

subject: Add text block deep linking for document source citations
message:
Add text block deep linking for document source citations

Enable deep linking to arbitrary text blocks in documents WITHOUT creating
database annotations. This allows source citations from corpus agent chat
to be clickable and navigate directly to the cited text.

URL format uses compact encoding in ?tb= query parameter:
  - Text spans: ?tb=s{start}-{end} (e.g., ?tb=s100-500)
  - PDF tokens: ?tb=p{page}:{ranges} (e.g., ?tb=p0:45-65;p1:0-23)

Changes:
- New textBlockEncoding.ts with encode/decode utilities and type-safe
  conversion helpers for spans, PAWLS tokens, and bounding boxes
- New TextBlockHighlight component for rendering ephemeral PDF highlights
- highlightedTextBlock reactive var in cache.ts with bidirectional URL sync
- CentralRouteManager Phase 2/4 integration for ?tb= parameter
- PDFPage renders text block highlights from URL state
- TxtAnnotatorWrapper injects text block spans as virtual chat sources
- WebSocketSources extended with document_id/corpus_id from backend
- ChatMessageSource carries document_id/corpus_id for cross-doc navigation
- MarkdownMessageRenderer detects ?tb= URLs as "source" mention type
  with MapPin icon and sky-blue styling
- CorpusChat.onSourceNavigate callback for source citation navigation
- Corpuses view builds deep link URLs with GraphQL ID-based document
  references (CentralRouteManager handles ID→slug redirect)

message:

The test form in CustomJSONFieldFormTests used NullableJSONField (a model
field) instead of UTF8JSONFormField (a form field). Django's Form metaclass
ignores model fields, so the form had zero fields and is_valid() always
returned True — silently accepting malformed JSON.

Fix: use UTF8JSONFormField(required=False) so validation actually runs.
Re-enable test_form_with_invalid_json. Add formfield integration tests
on NullableJSONFieldTests to verify the model-to-form field chain
properly rejects invalid JSON.

import), consistent with other settings files.

  granular failure reporting.

  it's a read-only check that doesn't need its own import.

subject: Add CSP, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy security headers
message:
Add CSP, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy security headers

Add SecurityHeadersMiddleware that attaches Content-Security-Policy,
Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy headers to all HTTP responses.
Headers are configured via Django settings (SECURE_CSP_DIRECTIVES,
SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY, SECURE_PERMISSIONS_POLICY) and pre-built once
at startup for zero per-request overhead. CSP allows 'self', inline
styles (React), blob:/data: (PDF.js), and WebSocket connections.
Permissions-Policy disables camera, microphone, geolocation, payment,
USB, magnetometer, gyroscope, and accelerometer.

subject: Fix My Documents corpus not navigable due to missing slugs
message:
Fix My Documents corpus not navigable due to missing slugs

Migration 0038 created personal corpuses using historical models which
bypass Corpus.save() slug auto-generation, leaving slug=NULL. The
frontend requires both corpus.slug and creator.slug to build navigation
URLs (/c/<user>/<corpus>), causing "Cannot navigate to corpus without
slugs" errors when clicking the My Documents corpus.

Two-part fix:
- get_or_create_personal_corpus() now detects and backfills missing
  slugs on access, so any code path that touches the personal corpus
  will self-heal.
- Data migration 0043 proactively backfills slugs for all existing
  corpuses and users that lack them.

subject: Add safety-net migrations to rename placeholder index names
message:
Add safety-net migrations to rename placeholder index names

Existing databases have indexes with hand-crafted hash suffixes that
don't match what Django generates. The previous commit fixed the
source migrations for fresh installs, but existing databases still
have the old names. These migrations use ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS to
rename old -> correct names, which is a no-op on fresh installs.

Affected apps:
- worker_uploads: 7 indexes (WorkerAccount, CorpusAccessToken, WorkerDocumentUpload)
- corpuses: 1 index (Corpus creator+is_personal)
- extracts: 2 indexes (Datacell document indexes)

message:
Extract validate_csp_domain(), scope local dev CSP to localhost

Fix three issues from PR review:

1. Auth0 domain validation was untestable: inline logic in base.py
   runs at module-load time so override_settings cannot re-execute it,
   and the previous tests were tautological (tested inline raises, not
   production code). Extract validation into validate_csp_domain() in
   config/middleware.py. Tests now call the real production function.

2. local.py silently discards Auth0 domain from connect-src when it
   replaces the list wholesale. Added a clear comment explaining this
   side-effect and how to work around it.

3. Bare wss:/ws: scheme sources in local.py allowed WebSocket
   connections to arbitrary external hosts. Scoped to localhost only:
   ws://localhost:* and wss://localhost:*.

subject: Add --init-only flag to prevent sync-preferences from overwriting admin config
message:
Add --init-only flag to prevent sync-preferences from overwriting admin config

The --sync-preferences command was unconditionally overwriting DB values on
every container startup, silently wiping admin-configured pipeline preferences.
This was especially problematic for ENABLED_COMPONENTS and PREFERRED_THUMBNAILERS
which aren't defined in Django settings and always reset to empty defaults.

The new --init-only flag skips fields that already have non-empty values,
making it safe for startup scripts while still seeding defaults on first run.

subject: Optimize vector search for million-scale corpora
message:
Optimize vector search for million-scale corpora

Add HNSW indexes on all Embedding vector columns (384-4096 dims) to
replace O(n) sequential scans with O(log n) approximate nearest neighbor
search. Eliminate Python-side materialization in search_by_embedding()
that previously loaded all matching rows into memory for sorting.

Add PostgreSQL full-text search via SearchVectorField + GIN index on
Annotation with auto-populating database trigger, replacing LIKE '%term%'
(icontains) with indexed tsvector matching.

Implement hybrid search combining vector similarity and full-text search
using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) in CoreAnnotationVectorStore, with
the semantic search GraphQL resolver now using hybrid search.

Upgrade pgvector from 0.7.0 to 0.8.0 for iterative index scans that
prevent result loss on filtered ANN queries. Tune PostgreSQL for vector
workloads (shared_buffers, maintenance_work_mem, parallel workers).

message:
Address PR review round 2: fix race condition, security defaults, and code quality

- Fix TOCTOU race in is_rate_limited: replace incr-first pattern with
  atomic add()+incr() so concurrent requests cannot both initialize the
  key and lose an increment

  behind a single reverse proxy use the rightmost (non-spoofable) XFF

  frame for WS_CONNECT checks where the connection is immediately closed
- Replace generic ValueError with MCPRateLimitError exception class for
  MCP rate limit rejections, making intent unambiguous for callers
- Expose request.limited on GraphQL context for block=False mode so
  resolvers can detect throttling without raising
- Replace asyncio.new_event_loop().run_until_complete() with
  asyncio.run() in rate limit tests to prevent event loop resource leaks
- Fix test_rate_limit_overrides to construct fresh _RateLimits instance
  instead of reloading module (avoids stale singleton reference)
- Fix ContextVar cleanup: use .reset(token) instead of .set(token) to
  properly restore previous value and prevent test pollution
- Add clarifying comments for _is_authenticated callable guard and
  retry_after calculation

subject: Fix dynamic icon resolution for forwardRef components
message:
Fix dynamic icon resolution for forwardRef components

Lucide React icons created via `createLucideIcon` use `React.forwardRef`,
which returns an object (typeof "object") rather than a function. The
dynamic fallback in `lookupIcon` was checking `typeof === "function"`
and failing to resolve icons not in the explicit KNOWN_ICONS map.

Replace the type check with `isIconComponent()` that handles both plain
functions and forwardRef objects (which have a `render` property). Update
test expectation: "banana" is now a valid Lucide icon resolved via the
dynamic fallback, so use a genuinely nonexistent name instead.

subject: Fix serial marker causing InterfaceError and add missing refetchComponents
message:
Fix serial marker causing InterfaceError and add missing refetchComponents

Remove module-level pytestmark = pytest.mark.serial from
test_pipeline_settings.py. The test settings already use LocMemCache
(per-process), so there is no cross-worker cache contention. The serial
marker was grouping all ~20 test classes onto one xdist worker, causing
InterfaceError: connection already closed failures when mixed with
TransactionTestCase tests on the same worker.

Also fix resetSettings mutation handler missing refetchComponents() call,
which left ComponentLibrary showing stale enabled state after a reset.

Remove redundant cache.delete before get_instance(use_cache=False) in
EnabledComponentsMutationTestCase.setUp.

message:
Address PR review: ef_search, async hybrid search, production tuning, constants cleanup

- Increase hnsw.ef_search from 40 to 64 to match ef_construction for
  better recall in legal document search (init.sql + migration 0063)

  event-loop issues

  value is only needed during initial HNSW index build)

  module level in mixins.py, conversations/models.py, and
  core_vector_stores.py (no circular import risk from constants module)
- Lower log level for dimension > HNSW_HIGHEST_INDEXED_DIM from WARNING
  to INFO since it is expected behavior for larger embedding models

message:
Fix CI test failure and address code review feedback

- Fix pre-existing bug in Corpus.save() where preferred_embedder was not
  set when get_default_embedder_path() returned empty string. The condition
  `if not self.preferred_embedder and default_embedder` skipped assignment
  because empty string is falsy. Changed to `if self.preferred_embedder is
  None` so the field is always populated from the default, fixing the
  test_preferred_embedder_auto_populated_from_default assertion failure.

- Remove stale postProcessors field from PipelineComponentsType TypeScript
  type. The system settings GQL query no longer fetches it, so the field
  was always undefined. The export modal uses its own inline type and is
  unaffected.

subject: Address code review: wire async_search to hybrid, DRY fusion logic, add tests
message:
Address code review: wire async_search to hybrid, DRY fusion logic, add tests

- Wire async_search() to delegate to async_hybrid_search() when a text
  query is present, mirroring the sync resolver logic so callers get
  full hybrid search benefit regardless of sync/async path.

- Extract shared _fuse_results() and _run_fts_query() helpers to
  eliminate ~80 lines of duplicated fusion logic between hybrid_search()
  and async_hybrid_search(). Both methods now share the same RRF fusion
  and FTS query code.

- Move reciprocal_rank_fusion import to module level (was duplicated in
  two local scopes).

- Add integration tests (test_hybrid_search.py):
  * TestHybridSearch: end-to-end sync/async hybrid search, vector-only
    fallback, text-only fallback, async_search delegation
  * TestSearchByEmbeddingRefactor: list return type, top_k, similarity
    scores, ordering, embedder filtering
  * TestSearchVectorTrigger: INSERT populates tsvector, UPDATE refreshes
    it, NULL/empty raw_text handled
  * TestReciprocalRankFusion: single list, overlap boosting, top_n cap

- Convert TODO comments to NOTE(deferred) in search constants and
  migration 0063 per project conventions.

- Remove redundant init.sql volume mounts from local.yml and test.yml
  (the Postgres Dockerfile already COPYs init.sql into the image).

subject: Disconnect DocumentPath post_save signal in test conftest
message:
Disconnect DocumentPath post_save signal in test conftest

The process_doc_on_document_path_create signal (added in 8729e98e)
triggers calculate_embedding_for_doc_text when a DocumentPath is
created. This was not disconnected in the test conftest alongside
the other document/annotation processing signals.

When running tests in parallel with pytest-xdist, the signal could
fire during BaseFixtureTestCase.setUp() -> corpus.add_document(),
causing EmbeddingGenerationError when PipelineSettings had no valid
default embedder configured (e.g. after EnabledComponentsMutationTestCase
cleared it to empty string).

Disconnect/reconnect the DocumentPath signal in both the session-scoped
disable_document_processing_signals fixture and the per-test
enable_doc_processing_signals fixture.

message:

Discovery endpoints (robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap.xml,
.well-known/mcp.json) are now served dynamically by Django instead of
as static files from frontend nginx.

Key improvements:
- llms.txt and llms-full.txt auto-populate Available Collections from
  the database, showing public corpuses with titles, slugs, doc counts
- Hostnames resolved from request instead of THIS_HOST placeholder
- robots.txt explicitly welcomes AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.)
- New sitemap.xml lists public corpuses and documents via DocumentPath
- New .well-known/mcp.json provides MCP server discovery
- Traefik routes discovery paths to Django in prod and CI configs
- Links use proper inline Markdown format per llmstxt.org spec
- All responses cached for 5 minutes to avoid repeated DB hits
- Comprehensive test suite (6 test classes, 30+ test methods)

subject: Fix rate limiting bugs, test failures, and security naming issue
message:
Fix rate limiting bugs, test failures, and security naming issue

- Fix FailOpen test failures: patch _get_cache instead of non-existent
  module-level cache in engine.py (tests were patching a name that
  didn't exist, so mock never intercepted actual cache calls)
- Fix cache.incr() race on window boundary: catch ValueError separately
  when key expires between add() returning False and incr(), and
  reinitialize counter to 1 instead of treating as cache failure
- Add Retry-After response header (RFC 6585) to 429 responses in
  view_ratelimit decorator, computed from remaining window seconds
- Rename telemetry get_client_ip_from_scope to
  get_claimed_client_ip_from_scope to distinguish from the rate-limiting
  version (telemetry uses leftmost XFF for analytics, rate limiting uses
  rightmost for anti-spoofing)
- Batch asyncio.run() calls in MCP rate limiter tests into single
  coroutines to avoid per-iteration event loop creation overhead

subject: Fix add_annotations_from_exact_strings OpenAI schema error
message:
Fix add_annotations_from_exact_strings OpenAI schema error

The tool's parameter type `list[tuple[str, str, int, int]]` produced a
JSON Schema with `prefixItems` (fixed-length typed arrays), which the
OpenAI function calling API does not support — it requires `items` on
all array types.

Changed the parameter from `list[tuple]` to `list[dict]` with named
keys (label_text, exact_string, document_id, corpus_id). This produces
a valid OpenAI-compatible schema and is more self-documenting for the
LLM.

Updated all callers: pydantic_ai_agents.py and test_llm_annotation_tools.py.

subject: Fix PostgreSQL HNSW config warning by preloading pgvector extension
message:
Fix PostgreSQL HNSW config warning by preloading pgvector extension

The warning "invalid configuration parameter name 'hnsw.iterative_scan'"
occurred because database-level GUC settings were applied before the
pgvector extension loaded, creating placeholder variables that conflicted
with MarkGUCPrefixReserved("hnsw"). Adding shared_preload_libraries=vector
ensures pgvector registers its GUC variables at server startup, before
database-level settings are applied.

Also upgrades pgvector from v0.8.0 to v0.8.2 (latest stable).

Closes #1074

https://claude.ai/code/session_01MPBVttFc7m5ykTGwN9zXBU

subject: Fix token bounding box drift by normalizing PAWLs coordinates to PDF.js viewport
message:
Fix token bounding box drift by normalizing PAWLs coordinates to PDF.js viewport

PAWLs tokens are extracted by the parser (Docling, pdfplumber, etc.) using its
own page dimension measurements. PDF.js computes page dimensions from the PDF's
MediaBox/CropBox/rotation, which can differ. When these dimensions don't match,
token bounding boxes progressively drift from the rendered text.

Added normalizeTokensToPdfViewport() which compares the PAWLs page.width/height
against the PDF.js viewport dimensions at scale 1 and rescales token coordinates
when they differ. Applied in both PDF loading paths in DocumentKnowledgeBase.tsx.

https://claude.ai/code/session_015A6AjzcvLpNAZ1KNuVyhtq

message:

  eliminating the unsafe cast in keyboard event handlers

  and OS_LEGAL_TYPOGRAPHY.fontFamilySans design tokens
- Remove unnecessary useCallback wrapper around position calculation

CorpusListView:
- Refactor IIFE render pattern to use early-return guard clauses

- Update Documents.ct.tsx and Extracts.ct.tsx to use role="menu" and
  role="menuitem" selectors instead of old Semantic UI .ui.menu.vertical
  class selectors that no longer exist after the menu replacement

subject: Fix CreateExtractModal not opening by adding portal and missing modal instance
message:
Fix CreateExtractModal not opening by adding portal and missing modal instance

Two bugs prevented the Create Extract modal from appearing:

1. After removing the Semantic UI Modal wrapper (b5aeb4af), the custom
   ModalOverlay with position:fixed rendered inline inside App.tsx's
   triple-nested overflow:hidden containers, clipping the modal content.
   Fixed by adding createPortal(content, document.body) to CreateExtractModal,
   FieldsetModal, and SelectCorpusAnalyzerOrFieldsetAnalyzer.

2. The Corpus Tabs Extracts view (ExtractCards) set the showCreateExtractModal
   reactive var on button click, but Corpuses.tsx never imported or rendered
   CreateExtractModal — the var was written but never consumed. Added the
   modal to the Corpuses view Modals section with the corpus ID passed through.

subject: Add ephemeral buffer fields to CoreConversationManager for anonymous sessions
message:
Add ephemeral buffer fields to CoreConversationManager for anonymous sessions

- Add `_ephemeral_messages`, `_ephemeral_token_estimate`, `_ephemeral_next_id`
  fields to `CoreConversationManager.__init__` for in-memory message tracking
- Import `SimpleNamespace` from stdlib for lightweight message objects
- In `create_for_corpus` and `create_for_document` anonymous blocks, change
  store flags from False to True so the ephemeral path is activated
- Add `TestEphemeralConversationManager` test class with helper and buffer
  initialisation tests

Implement ephemeral store_user_message and create_placeholder_message

- `store_user_message` (ephemeral branch): appends SimpleNamespace with
  msg_type="HUMAN" to buffer and updates `_ephemeral_token_estimate`
- `create_placeholder_message` (ephemeral branch): allocates the next
  synthetic ID without appending to the buffer, preventing double-write
- Fix `CoreAgentBase.create_placeholder_message` to delegate entirely to
  `conversation_manager.create_placeholder_message`, removing the old
  return-0-for-anonymous path that caused `if llm_msg_id:` to be falsy

Implement ephemeral complete_message, update_message, and get_conversation_messages

- `get_conversation_messages`: returns `list(self._ephemeral_messages)` for
  ephemeral sessions instead of empty list
- `complete_message`: appends SimpleNamespace with msg_type="LLM" for ephemeral
  sessions, updating token estimate
- `update_message`: finds message by ID and updates content, adjusting token
  estimate delta for ephemeral sessions

Add context_exhausted property to CoreConversationManager

- New `context_exhausted` property returns False for DB conversations and empty
  buffers; returns True when `_ephemeral_token_estimate > context_window * 0.9`
- Uses `get_context_window_for_model` from context_guardrails for model lookup
- Add corresponding tests verifying initial state, exhaustion threshold, and
  that DB sessions always return False

Guard ephemeral complete_message against None/0 message_id from _stream_core

- Add `if not message_id: return` at the top of the ephemeral branch in
  `complete_message` to prevent double-write: `_stream_core` calls
  `complete_message(None, ...)` internally, then `CoreAgentBase.stream()`
  calls `complete_message(real_id, ...)` — without the guard the buffer
  would receive two entries
- Add tests for None, 0, and the full double-write scenario

subject: Add context exhaustion check to WebSocket consumer for anonymous sessions
message:
Add context exhaustion check to WebSocket consumer for anonymous sessions

Before streaming a response, receive() now checks whether the agent's
conversation_manager.context_exhausted property is True. If so, an
ASYNC_ERROR with error_type "CONTEXT_EXHAUSTED" is returned to the
client and streaming is skipped, preventing calls into an ephemeral
buffer that has already exceeded 90% of the model's context window.

Three unit tests are added to UnifiedAgentConsumerContextExhaustionTestCase
covering: exhausted path sends error and skips stream, non-exhausted path
proceeds normally, and agents without a conversation_manager attribute
are handled gracefully.

subject: Compact annotation JSON format (v2) to reduce verbosity and remove dead fields
message:
Compact annotation JSON format (v2) to reduce verbosity and remove dead fields

Introduce a compact v2 annotation JSON format that replaces verbose v1 structures:
- v1: {"0": {"bounds": {top,left,right,bottom}, "tokensJsons": [{pageIndex,tokenIndex},...], "rawText": "..."}}
- v2: {"v": 2, "p": {"0": {"b": [top,left,right,bottom], "t": "35-37,40"}}}

Token indices use range encoding (e.g., [35,36,37,40] → "35-37,40") for significant
size reduction. rawText is reconstructed from document tokens on expand.

Backwards compatible: expand_annotation_json() normalizes v2→v1 for all readers.
Auto-compaction on Annotation.save() implements lazy migration (no batch needed).
Exports always produce v2. Imports accept both formats.

Remove dead model fields `tokens_jsons` and `bounding_box` from Annotation model -
these were never populated by any parser and never read by any code path. Includes
Django migration 0066 and updates to all GraphQL queries, serializers, tests, and
fixtures.

New modules:
- opencontractserver/annotations/compact_json.py (backend encode/decode/compact/expand)
- frontend/src/utils/compactAnnotationJson.ts (frontend mirror)

Closes #annotation-json-verbosity

https://claude.ai/code/session_019qPFoP7JBdNnTWCKKNPNLG

- DocumentKnowledgeBase DOCX loading flow and renderer dispatch
- isDocxFileType utility, DOCX_MIME_TYPE constant, docxBytesAtom

and doc_tasks.convert_doc_to_funsd were not v2-aware.

Includes 34 new unit tests (27 Python + 14 TypeScript) covering the
accessor layer across both formats.

subject: Add compact PAWLs v2 format for ~67% storage reduction
message:
Add compact PAWLs v2 format for ~67% storage reduction

PAWLs files store per-page token bounding boxes and are typically the
largest per-document artifact (500+ KB for a 9-page PDF). The new v2
compact format reduces this by:

- Array-based tokens: [x, y, w, h, "text"] instead of verbose dicts
- Shortened page keys: w/h instead of width/height
- Implicit page index from array position
- Coordinate precision normalization to 1 decimal place
- Separated image metadata as compact 6th-element dict

Write paths (parser, import, worker upload) now auto-compact on save.
Read paths transparently expand v2 back to v1, so all existing
consumers (build_translation_layer, spatial queries, exports, LLM
tools) work unchanged. Frontend mirrors the decoder in compactPawls.ts
and expands in the REST fetch layer.

Measured on real fixture: 549 KB → 180 KB (67.1% reduction).

subject: Fix DocxAnnotator component tests: split mixed imports for Playwright CT
message:
Fix DocxAnnotator component tests: split mixed imports for Playwright CT

Playwright CT's babel transform fails to replace component refs with import
refs when non-component exports (sampleDocText) are imported alongside
component exports in the same import statement. The transform only removes
the import when ALL specifiers are used in JSX; mixed imports leave both
the original import and the generated const declarations, causing the
component type to remain as a function instead of an importRef object.

Split the import so component names are on a separate statement from
non-component exports.

subject: Add annotation sidecar import for bulk zip upload
message:
Add annotation sidecar import for bulk zip upload

Extend ImportZipToCorpus to support importing pre-calculated annotations
alongside source documents. When a document file (e.g. contracts/master.pdf)
has a co-located .json sidecar (e.g. contracts/master.json) conforming to
OpenContractDocExport, annotations and intra-document relationships are
imported from the sidecar instead of running the parser pipeline.

A root-level labels.json file provides label definitions needed by the
annotation sidecars. Documents without sidecars continue through the
normal parser pipeline, enabling mixed-mode imports.

Changes:
- opencontractserver/utils/zip_security.py: Add sidecar and labels.json
  detection to ZipManifest. New helpers: is_labels_file(),
  is_annotation_sidecar(), LABELS_FILE_NAMES. Sidecar matching builds a
  map of document path -> sidecar original_path after the main validation
  loop.
- opencontractserver/tasks/import_tasks.py: Add Phase 2.5 (label setup
  from labels.json) and sidecar-aware Phase 3 to
  import_zip_with_folder_structure. New _import_document_with_sidecar()
  helper reuses create_document_from_export_data(), import_doc_annotations(),
  and import_relationships() from the V2 corpus import path.
- opencontractserver/tests/test_sidecar_import.py: Integration tests with
  real PDF fixtures and realistic PAWLs/annotation data covering: manifest
  detection, single/multiple annotated imports, intra-doc relationships,
  mixed sidecar+pipeline imports, subfolder support, cross-doc
  relationships.csv, label set auto-creation, and backward compatibility.

subject: Add skip_pipeline option to sidecar imports
message:
Add skip_pipeline option to sidecar imports

When a sidecar JSON contains "skip_pipeline": true, the document is
created directly from the sidecar's export data (PAWLs, text, etc.)
using create_document_from_export_data + add_document — the parser
pipeline is not triggered. When the field is absent or false (default),
the existing additive behavior is preserved: document goes through the
pipeline and sidecar annotations are layered on top.

Implementation:
- Extract _read_sidecar() to pre-parse sidecar before deciding the
  creation path (also avoids reading the sidecar twice)
- Refactor _apply_sidecar_annotations() to accept pre-parsed doc_data
  instead of reading from the zip handle
- Add pipeline_skipped counter to result tracking
- Add two new tests: skip_pipeline=True and skip_pipeline=False paths

  with PDF/TXT annotation display
- Remove container lineHeight/color overrides that conflicted with
  docxodus document styles

subject: Replace React label overlays with CSS ::before pseudo-element labels
message:
Replace React label overlays with CSS ::before pseudo-element labels

The React-based label overlays had positioning issues (computed from
getBoundingClientRect which is viewport-relative, not scroll-relative).

Switch to pure CSS approach: annotation spans with data-label and
data-label-id attributes get ::before pseudo-elements that display the
label text. The spans use position:relative and the labels float above
via position:absolute with top:-1.4em.

This avoids all scroll/position computation, DOM disruption, and the
styled-components prop warnings from RadialButtonCloud.

subject: Support cross-page text selection for DOCX annotations
message:
Support cross-page text selection for DOCX annotations

When a selection spans page boundaries in PaginatedDocument, the selected
text includes page number artifacts and extra whitespace that don't exist
in docText, causing findTextOccurrences to return no matches and silently
breaking the annotation menu for all subsequent selections.

Fix by resolving both anchor and focus positions via DOM offset
computation (getGlobalOffsetFromDomPosition) which walks text nodes
and counts characters, giving exact start/end offsets in docText
regardless of page boundaries. Fall back to text matching for single-
page selections where DOM resolution fails.

Also:
- Skip page-number elements in the TreeWalker (PaginatedDocument injects
  these as visible text nodes that aren't part of docText)
- Wrap handleMouseUp in try/catch to prevent uncaught errors from
  corrupting component state and breaking subsequent interactions

subject: Fix text selection: use text matching instead of broken DOM offset counting
message:
Fix text selection: use text matching instead of broken DOM offset counting

The DOM offset walker counted ALL text in the PaginatedDocument DOM
(including CSS from <style> tags, page numbers, attribute text) producing
offsets far beyond docText.length. This made every selection fail the
"empty text or zero range" check.

Replace with text-matching approach using findTextOccurrences:
1. Clean selected text by stripping page number artifacts (\n1\n → \n)
2. Search cleaned text in docText via findTextOccurrences
3. If no exact match (whitespace differences from cross-page), try
   whitespace-normalized fuzzy matching
4. Use DOM position only for disambiguation when multiple matches exist

Also skip <style> and <title> tags in the TreeWalker (still used for
disambiguation), though the primary path no longer relies on DOM offsets.

subject: Fix CSP violations on admin login page (#1133)
message:
Fix CSP violations on admin login page (#1133)

* Fix CSP violations on admin login page with per-request nonces

The admin login template had inline <script> blocks and inline event
handlers (onclick, onerror) that were blocked by CSP's script-src
directive. Add per-request cryptographic nonce generation to the
SecurityHeadersMiddleware, inject nonces into script-src, and refactor
the template to use nonce-tagged scripts with addEventListener instead
of inline event handler attributes.

* Address review: fix SDK error handler race, nonce scope, and CSP fallback

- Move handleScriptError to a script block before the SDK tag so the
  onerror attribute can reference it when the browser starts fetching
- Inject nonce into script-src-elem when that directive is present
- Skip nonce generation when CSP is not configured
- Log a warning when csp_nonce is missing from the request instead of
  silently using an empty string that would block all inline scripts

Proposes a navigable hierarchical index for long documents using
annotations with a new `long_description` field, the existing parent
hierarchy, and a "Document Index Entry" label convention. Covers
agent-driven index creation, deterministic import via extended export
format, and a hybrid CorpusHome view.

* Add document index feature with long_description and OC_SECTION label

Implement a within-document hierarchical index using annotations:

Backend:
- Add long_description TextField to Annotation model (migration 0066)
- Add OC_SECTION label constant with OC_ namespace convention
- New create_document_index agent tool for building hierarchical
  indexes from exact string matches with markdown descriptions
- Extend export/import to include long_description field
- Expose long_description in GraphQL type, mutation, and serializer

Frontend:
- New DocumentAnnotationIndex component with tree rendering,
  expandable markdown descriptions, page badges, and filtering

https://claude.ai/code/session_01JqjVhmbW4PnRRNfAfsPoS3

* Add component tests and test wrapper for DocumentAnnotationIndex

Playwright component tests covering hierarchy rendering, expand/collapse,
markdown descriptions, empty state, flat layout, ARIA accessibility,
keyboard navigation, depth limits, embedded mode, and filter behavior.
Includes docScreenshot calls for auto-generated documentation images.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01JqjVhmbW4PnRRNfAfsPoS3

* Fix linting and formatting issues

Apply black/isort formatting to backend files and prettier formatting
to frontend files to fix CI lint failures.

* Address code review feedback

- Fix isSingleDoc to use unfiltered rootNodes instead of filteredNodes
- Guard against None file_type with early error
- Preserve nullable semantics for long_description (None instead of "")
- Move ensure_label_and_labelset inside transaction.atomic() block
- Add self-referential parent_index guard
- Log warning when exact_string has multiple matches in document
- Replace hardcoded warning banner colors with OS_LEGAL_COLORS tokens
- Remove unused documentSlug prop from DocumentAnnotationIndexProps
- Make parent_index and long_description NotRequired in IndexEntryItem

* Fix component tests and add documentation screenshots

- Fix exact text matching for page badges (getByText strict mode)
- Auto-expand annotation index tree when filter is active
- Add docScreenshot calls to DocumentTableOfContents tests

* Add backend tests for create_document_index and fix section navigation

Backend tests (12 tests):
- PDF: flat index, hierarchical parent wiring, transaction rollback
- Text: SPAN_LABEL creation, hierarchy with parent FK
- Error paths: string not found, parent out of range, self-referential
  parent, nonexistent document, document not in corpus, unsupported
  file type, empty file type

Navigation fix:
- Section click now passes annotation ID via ?ann= URL param
- CentralRouteManager syncs this to selectedAnnotationIds reactive var
- PDF viewer scrolls to the annotation via two-phase scroll system
- Add queryParams support to navigateToRelationshipDocument

* Fix black formatting in test_document_index_tool.py

  to prevent stored XSS via LLM-generated long_description content

  DocumentAnnotationIndex and DocumentTableOfContents to avoid
  the React anti-pattern of defining components inside render
  functions (causes unnecessary subtree remounts)

  siblings, ArrowRight into first child, ArrowLeft to parent)
- Remove sync create_document_index from tool registry (tests import it
  directly from core_tools; registering it was a latent SynchronousOnlyOperation

- Detect orphan nodes whose parent is outside the fetched set and promote

- Extract DOCUMENT_ANNOTATION_INDEX_MAX_DEPTH constant (no magic numbers)

toHaveCSS matcher, which retries until the CSS property matches. This
eliminates the race condition where styled-components' CSS injection
hasn't completed by the time the cursor style is checked.

- Add UpdateAnnotation long_description serializer tests (2 tests)
- Add export/import round-trip tests for long_description (2 tests)
- Convert design proposal doc to present-tense architecture reference

Add comprehensive documentation for downstream consumers building
document indexes in OpenContractDocExport ZIPs:

- Add long_description field to the Annotation field reference table

- Add full "Document Index Convention" section with step-by-step guide,

Replace document_index_proposal.md with document_annotation_index.md
that consolidates architecture decisions, component map, and data flow.
Add cross-reference from corpus-export-format-spec.md.

* Address review feedback: fix resource leak, export fidelity, and UX issues

- Fix PAWLS file resource leak: use context manager instead of try/finally
  in create_document_index (core_tools.py)
- Fix export round-trip for long_description="": use `is not None` check
  instead of truthiness test in etl.py and export_v2.py
- Use nullish coalescing (??) instead of || for longDescription to preserve
  empty string semantics (DocumentAnnotationIndex.tsx)
- Use OS_LEGAL_TYPOGRAPHY.fontFamilySans design token instead of hardcoded
  font-family in NodeTitle styled component
- Reset expanded nodes when filter query is cleared so sections collapse
  back to default state
- Narrow useMemo dependency to annotations edges array to avoid unnecessary
  recomputation on Apollo background refetches

* Address review: fix PAWLS resource leak, add annotation index empty state

Convert remaining try/finally PAWLS file patterns to context managers in
add_annotations_from_exact_strings and search_exact_text_as_sources.

Show "No indexed sections" message in DocumentAnnotationIndex when
embedded in the TOC tree and no OC_SECTION annotations exist, so the
expand chevron is no longer a silent no-op.

* Address review: fix N+1 writes, a11y violation, broken navigation, and query filter

- Refactor create_document_index to use bulk_create + bulk_update instead of
  individual .save() calls (reduces ~1000 SQL queries to ~2 for 500 entries)
- Move validation (string matching, cycle detection) before any DB writes
- Fix nested role="tree" WAI-ARIA violation: embedded annotation index now
  uses role="group" when mounted inside DocumentTableOfContents
- Fix broken section-click navigation by passing document slug through
  DocumentAnnotationIndex props (getDocumentUrl was returning "#")
- Add structural: false filter to GET_DOCUMENT_ANNOTATION_INDEX query
- Change fetchPolicy from cache-and-network to cache-first for read-only data
- Add DOCUMENT_ANNOTATION_INDEX_MAX_DEPTH constant to backend
- Add return type annotation to acreate_document_index async wrapper
- Update embedded mode test to match new role="group" behavior

The test suite now has 1176+ component tests which takes just over 10
minutes on CI with 2 workers. Bump the globalTimeout to 15 minutes to
provide headroom as the test suite grows.

Collapsed description previews now use a lightweight stripMarkdown()
helper instead of ReactMarkdown+rehypeSanitize, avoiding unnecessary
AST parsing for every collapsed node and preventing raw markdown
syntax from showing in the 2-line clamped preview.

Convert remaining try/finally PAWLS file patterns to context managers in
add_annotations_from_exact_strings and search_exact_text_as_sources.

embedded in the TOC tree and no OC_SECTION annotations exist, so the
expand chevron is no longer a silent no-op.

  individual .save() calls (reduces ~1000 SQL queries to ~2 for 500 entries)

  uses role="group" when mounted inside DocumentTableOfContents

The test suite now has 1176+ component tests which takes just over 10
minutes on CI with 2 workers. Bump the globalTimeout to 15 minutes to
provide headroom as the test suite grows.

Collapsed description previews now use a lightweight stripMarkdown()
helper instead of ReactMarkdown+rehypeSanitize, avoiding unnecessary
AST parsing for every collapsed node and preventing raw markdown
syntax from showing in the 2-line clamped preview.

subject: Add caching to community stats resolver to reduce database queries (#1126)
message:

  COUNT queries (annotation visibility, conversation visibility, user
  counts, badge distribution) on every landing page load
- Fix badge distribution N+1: replace per-badge Badge.objects.get() loop
  with single Badge.objects.in_bulk() batch query

  instead of materializing the full ID list into Python memory

* Make community stats cache TTL configurable via env var, default 1 hour

COMMUNITY_STATS_CACHE_TTL env var (seconds) allows tuning without
code changes. Raised default from 120s to 3600s since hour-old
aggregate stats are acceptable for the landing page.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01TsoURmSAsvZaEBU8W4bd4V

* Address review: cache primitives, fix constants re-export, clean imports

- Cache plain dicts instead of Graphene ObjectType instances to avoid
  fragile pickle serialization of Django model objects with Redis/Memcached
- Add community_stats to constants/__init__.py re-export for consistency
- Move cache and COMMUNITY_STATS_CACHE_TTL imports to module level
- On cache hit, reconstruct Graphene types from cached primitives with a
  single in_bulk() query for badges (far cheaper than the 7+ COUNT queries)

subject: Fix CSP blocking Auth0 silent auth iframe and inline event handler
message:
Fix CSP blocking Auth0 silent auth iframe and inline event handler

Two CSP violations were preventing Auth0 from working:

1. frame-src: Auth0 SPA SDK uses a hidden iframe for silent authentication
   (prompt=none, response_mode=web_message) but no frame-src directive
   existed, causing fallback to default-src 'self' which blocked it.
   Added frame-src with the Auth0 tenant domain.

2. script-src-attr: The onerror="handleScriptError()" inline event handler
   on the SDK script tag was blocked because CSP treats inline event handlers
   under script-src-attr (not script-src-elem as the old comment claimed),
   and nonces do not apply to inline event handlers. Replaced with
   dynamic script creation using addEventListener('error', ...).

subject: Resolve document for structural annotations in GraphQL
message:
Resolve document for structural annotations in GraphQL

Structural annotations have document=NULL and are linked to documents
via structural_annotation_set. The AnnotationType resolver now follows
this relationship so annotation cards display the correct document name
and generate navigable URLs instead of showing "Unknown Document".

subject: Defer structural annotation loading for PDF performance
message:
Defer structural annotation loading for PDF performance

Structural annotations (headers, sections, paragraphs) can number in
the thousands for large documents but are hidden by default. This
change removes them from the initial GraphQL queries and loads them
lazily only when the user toggles structural visibility on.

Changes:
- Remove allStructuralAnnotations from GET_DOCUMENT_KNOWLEDGE_AND_ANNOTATIONS,
  GET_DOCUMENT_ANNOTATIONS_ONLY, and GET_DOCUMENT_WITH_STRUCTURE queries
- Add standalone GET_DOCUMENT_STRUCTURAL_ANNOTATIONS query
- Add useLazyQuery in DocumentKnowledgeBase that fires when showStructural
  reactive var becomes true
- Add structuralAnnotationsLoadedAtom to prevent redundant re-fetching
- Reset structural state when navigating to a new document
- Remove structural annotation processing from processAnnotationsData()
  and processAnnotationsOnlyData() (structural annotations are
  analysis-independent and don't need re-fetching on analysis switch)

For a 200-page document this eliminates ~5-20MB of JSON from the
initial payload and avoids synchronous processing of ~5000 objects.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01GZu6gqWmAxMm4TTL7HrW79

subject: Fix selection menu off-screen test on mobile viewport
message:
Fix selection menu off-screen test on mobile viewport

The test was unreliable because it used a complex zoom+scroll+select
sequence (5x Ctrl++ zoom + horizontal scroll to right edge) on a
375x667 mobile viewport. This combination made the mouse selection
coordinates miss the SelectionLayer, so the action menu never appeared.

Simplified the test to follow the same reliable pattern as the passing
desktop viewport test: wait for canvas initialization, then select near
the right edge without zooming. This still validates the core behavior
(menu clamping within a narrow mobile viewport) without the fragile
zoom/scroll sequence. The zoom+scroll scenario is already covered by
the "selection menu stays visible with zoom and scroll" test.

subject: Add CAML (Corpus Article Markup Language) interactive article system
message:
Add CAML (Corpus Article Markup Language) interactive article system

Implement end-to-end support for rich, interactive scrollytelling articles
stored as Readme.CAML documents within a corpus. This is the document
convention approach (like GitHub's README) — the latest version of
Readme.CAML is always used.

Backend:
- Add text/markdown MIME type with no-op MarkdownParser that skips NLP
  pipeline (no PAWLs, no sentence annotations, no embeddings)
- Add title filter to DocumentFilter for exact-match document queries
- Detect .caml/.md files by extension during upload

Frontend - CAML Parser (frontend/src/caml/parser/):
- Pure function parseCaml(string) -> CamlDocument JSON IR
- Pass 1: YAML frontmatter extraction + ::: fence tokenization
- Pass 2: Type-specific block parsing (cards, pills, tabs, timeline,
  CTA, signup, corpus-stats, annotation-embed)
- Supports nested :::: fences for tab sub-blocks

Frontend - CAML Renderer (frontend/src/caml/renderer/):
- CamlArticle top-level renderer with Hero, Chapter, Footer
- Block components: Cards (grid), Pills (flex row), Tabs (interactive),
  Timeline (vertical), CTA (buttons), Signup, CorpusStats
- Prose blocks render through MarkdownMessageRenderer for @ mention
  chip support (reuses existing mention system)
- OS Legal design system styling with dark/light chapter themes

Frontend - Article View & Editor:
- New ?view=article route in CorpusHome orchestrator
- CorpusArticleView queries for Readme.CAML by title, fetches content,
  parses and renders
- Landing view shows "Read the article" link when Readme.CAML exists
- CamlArticleEditor: split-pane editor (CAML source + live preview)
  with create/update via UploadDocument mutation
- Edit button in article toolbar for quick access

subject: Fix anonymous user access to document relationships on public corpuses
message:
Fix anonymous user access to document relationships on public corpuses

The document relationship query resolvers incorrectly used @login_required,
blocking anonymous users even when the underlying resources (source doc,
target doc, corpus) are all public. Replaced with rate limiting decorators
consistent with other read resolvers, letting the existing permission
filtering via DocumentRelationshipQueryOptimizer.get_visible_relationships()
handle access control for both authenticated and anonymous users.

Updated the consolidated permissioning guide to document anonymous access
rules for DocumentRelationship and added test coverage for the scenario.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01GeojYBbzb7XSosJ3Y3TqP1

subject: Address review: fix failed-count calculation, restore retry semantics for transient errors, add shape guard
message:
Address review: fix failed-count calculation, restore retry semantics for transient errors, add shape guard

- Fix failed-count calculation on ValueError path by snapshotting
  result["skipped"] before calling _batch_embed_text_annotations and
  subtracting only the delta (empty-text skips), not partition-loop skips.

- Restore retry semantics for transient HTTP errors: requests.Timeout,
  requests.ConnectionError, and EmbeddingServerError (5xx) now re-raise
  from _batch_embed_text_annotations and embed_texts_batch so the
  task-level Celery autoretry_for=(Exception,) decorator can fire.
  Non-retriable errors (malformed response, NaN, count mismatch) remain
  as permanent per-annotation failures.

- Add 3D squeeze shape guard in MicroserviceEmbedder.embed_texts_batch,
  BaseMultimodalMicroserviceEmbedder.embed_texts_batch, and
  embed_images_batch: check shape[1]==1 before squeezing.

- Strengthen test assertion: test_batch_path_valueerror_fails_fast now
  asserts assertEqual(result["failed"], 3) instead of assertGreater.

- Replace module-level assert with ValueError raise in
  document_processing.py constants.

- Add tests for transient error propagation (Timeout, ConnectionError,
  EmbeddingServerError) in both _batch_embed_text_annotations and
  MicroserviceEmbedder.embed_texts_batch.

subject: Fix SelectionActionMenu z-index trapped in PDFContainer stacking context
message:
Fix SelectionActionMenu z-index trapped in PDFContainer stacking context

PDFContainer has position:relative + z-index:1, creating a CSS stacking
context that trapped the SelectionActionMenu's z-index inside it. External
elements (like EnhancedLabelSelector) intercepted clicks on the menu.

Fix: render SelectionActionMenu via React portal (document.body) in all
three annotators (TXT, PDF, DOCX) so it escapes the stacking context.
Replace hardcoded zIndex:1000 with Z_INDEX.CONTEXT_MENU constant.

Also add unmount cleanup for mouseLeaveTimeoutRef in ExtractCellFormatter
to prevent state updates on unmounted components.

subject: Skip entire processing pipeline for CAML/markdown documents
message:
Skip entire processing pipeline for CAML/markdown documents

The document creation signal was dispatching the full pipeline chain
(thumbnail → ingest → unlock) for CAML files. While ingest_doc already
exited early, extract_thumbnail still ran and failed to find a
thumbnailer. Now the signal handler marks CAML documents as complete
immediately without dispatching any Celery tasks.

Also adds a safety guard in extract_thumbnail for defense-in-depth,
and fixes a flaky minimize button test in FloatingSummaryPreview.

subject: Refactor document visibility to use data-level is_public propagation
message:
Refactor document visibility to use data-level is_public propagation

Replace the in_public_corpus_ids subquery hack in DocumentQuerySet with
proper data-level propagation: documents in public corpora now
automatically inherit is_public=True at creation time.

Three propagation points:
- Corpus.add_document(): sets is_public from corpus
- import_document(): sets is_public=corpus.is_public on new/updated docs
- Corpus.save(): propagates is_public changes to all corpus documents,
  with multi-corpus awareness (only revokes if doc not in another
  public corpus)

This preserves the permissioning guide's canonical rule (both document
AND corpus must be is_public=True) without queryset-level bypasses.

subject: Fix is_public duplicate keyword arg in Document.objects.create calls
message:

spread in import_document() and add_document(), causing

during document import/upload.

in versioning.py (both create and update paths) and models.py
(add_document). The explicit is_public parameter now also
incorporates the caller's doc_kwargs.get("is_public") value via
OR logic, preserving the intent of make_public=True from import
tasks.

Also adds defensive comments explaining redundant CAML/markdown
skip checks in doc_tasks.py (the signal guards first, but direct
Celery calls need the fallback).

  collectstatic, not run by the local start script).
- Add DJANGO_DEBUG=True to local sample env file so Django admin
  serves static files via runserver.

subject: Fix test interference: replace signal disconnect/reconnect with bypass pattern
message:
Fix test interference: replace signal disconnect/reconnect with bypass pattern

The _create_doc_without_signal() helper disconnected and reconnected
the Django post_save signal, which caused cross-test interference when
TestCase tests ran before TransactionTestCase tests (signal state
leaked between test classes, causing eager Celery tasks to fire and
fail on documents without real PDF files).

Replace with _create_doc_bypass_pipeline() that sets processing_started
at creation time so the signal guard naturally skips task queuing.
Tests that need to invoke the handler directly now use a DB-level
reset of processing_started before calling the handler.

subject: Fix corpus home landing zero-padding on mobile viewports
message:
Fix corpus home landing zero-padding on mobile viewports

LandingContent and LandingHero set width: 100% with horizontal
padding but no box-sizing: border-box, causing the rendered width
to exceed the viewport (e.g. 375 + 48 = 423px). The parent's
overflow-x: hidden clipped the overflow but the padding effectively
added no visible margin — content ran edge-to-edge.

Adding box-sizing: border-box to both containers ensures padding
is included within width: 100%, giving proper side margins on
mobile. No visual change on desktop where max-width: 800px already
constrains the layout well within the viewport.

https://claude.ai/code/session_019tDhDBf9zJPpLADHkW7YeL

subject: Security hardening: fix CSRF, IDOR, XSS, and DoS vectors
message:
Security hardening: fix CSRF, IDOR, XSS, and DoS vectors

- Conditional CSRF enforcement on GraphQL endpoint — session-auth
  requests now require CSRF tokens, token-auth requests are exempt
- Sanitize GraphQL mutation error messages to prevent internal state
  leakage (stack traces, DB schema, file paths)
- Validate Auth0 returnTo parameter to prevent open redirects
- Switch Auth0 token cache from localStorage to memory to limit XSS
  blast radius
- Add GraphQL query depth limiting (max 10) to prevent DoS via
  deeply-nested queries
- Disable GraphQL introspection in production (DEBUG=False)
- Fix TOCTOU race condition in DocumentPath management with
  select_for_update()
- Re-validate user permissions in Celery extract task at execution
  time (defense-in-depth)
- Replace innerHTML with DOMParser for safe HTML text extraction
- Require PERMISSION (not UPDATE) for badge creation on corpuses
- Add explicit SameSite=Lax cookie attributes
- Remove hardcoded default API key 'abc123' for vector embedder
- Remove '0.0.0.0' from default ALLOWED_HOSTS
- Increase HSTS max-age from 6 days to 1 year (OWASP recommendation)

subject: Add move_document_to_corpus agent tool
message:
Add move_document_to_corpus agent tool

Implements a new agent tool that moves a document from one corpus to
another by creating an isolated copy in the target corpus and
soft-deleting from the source. Delegates to DocumentFolderService for
both operations, inheriting its permission checks (write on both
corpuses required).

Key design decisions:
- corpus_id (source) and author_id are auto-injected from agent context
- target_corpus_id is LLM-provided since the agent needs to choose it
- document_id is context-dependent: auto-injected in document agents,
  LLM-provided in corpus agents
- requires_approval=True since removal from source is destructive
- Validates folder belongs to target corpus before proceeding

subject: Track document moves via DocumentPath history nodes
message:
Track document moves via DocumentPath history nodes

DocumentFolderService.move_document_to_folder() and
move_documents_to_folder() previously did in-place updates on
DocumentPath.folder, silently losing move history. Now they create new
DocumentPath records linked to the previous state via parent (Rules P1,
P2, P3, P5), making moves traversable through get_path_history().

Changes:
- folder_service: move_document_to_folder() creates a new DocumentPath
  node with parent=current instead of in-place .update(folder=folder)
- folder_service: move_documents_to_folder() does the same per-document
- folder_service: Add _compute_moved_path() helper to derive path string
  from target folder, with conflict resolution for occupied paths
- folder_service: Skip no-op moves (document already in target folder)
- versioning: get_path_history() now detects folder-only moves and
  includes folder_id in history entries
- tests: Updated move tests to verify new history nodes are created,
  parent chain is linked, version number is preserved, and same-folder
  moves are no-ops

Closes #6p1vd

message:

records, silently losing the move-to-root history when a folder was
deleted. Now it creates proper history nodes with parent chain, matching
the behavior of move_document_to_folder().

- V2 export already exports all DocumentPath records (including
  historical), so richer move history is captured automatically
- V2 import only processes is_current=True records, so historical
  move records from the export are safely skipped
- _reconstruct_document_paths() updates freshly created paths to
  match export data (initial state, not moves) — no change needed
- Fork tasks use corpus.add_document() at creation time — unaffected

subsequent loop iterations fail.

a ValueError to surface data quality issues instead of masking them.

Fix Istanbul coverage instrumentation not activating in CI

The vite-plugin-istanbul requireEnv option checked for VITE_COVERAGE in

Since loadIstanbulPlugins() already gates plugin loading on process.env.COVERAGE,
requireEnv is redundant and was silently disabling instrumentation.

Also ensure the .nyc_output directory exists before running nyc report so
the script doesn't fail when no coverage data has been written yet.

subject: Add auto-grounding pipeline for extraction results
message:
Add auto-grounding pipeline for extraction results

Extraction datacells now automatically link to source annotations with
precise document positions (PDF bounding boxes or text character offsets).

After the LLM agent extracts data, a post-processing step aligns the
extracted text values back to the source document using a three-tier
matching strategy (exact, normalized, fuzzy via difflib), then creates
Annotation objects via PlasmaPDF (PDFs) or span offsets (text/DOCX).

New files:
- utils/text_alignment.py — format-agnostic text-to-document aligner

nyc report step was skipped entirely and no lcov.info was generated.

Changed && to ; so nyc report always runs and generates coverage from
whatever tests completed. Also increased global timeout from 15 to 25
minutes when COVERAGE=true since Istanbul instrumentation adds overhead.

message:

Move current.save() inside the inner transaction.atomic() savepoint in
move_document_to_folder so that an IntegrityError on create rolls back
both the save and the create together. Previously, the save was outside
the savepoint, so an IntegrityError would leave the document with no
active path (is_current=False on the old path, no new path created).

after an IntegrityError. Add test for folder-only moves being detected
as MOVED in get_path_history (exercises the folder_id check in
determine_action). Improve _compute_moved_path docstring with examples.

subject: Fix malformed global ID handling and address review feedback
message:
Fix malformed global ID handling and address review feedback

- Fix resolve_ingestion_source to handle malformed base64 IDs that
  from_global_id decodes to empty strings without raising exceptions.
  Added explicit check for empty pk after decoding.

- Narrow exception handling from bare Exception to specific ValueError
  and TypeError; add ValueError/TypeError to the ORM .get() catch block
  to handle non-integer pk values gracefully.

- Remove inefficient subquery in IngestionSourceType.get_queryset that
  wrapped visible_to_user in pk__in filter; return the queryset directly.

- Add type annotations for lineage kwargs in import_document docstring.

to the ExtractPickerDropdown for screen reader accessibility, and adds an
inline comment to getDocumentUrl explaining why id fields are Partial.

subject: Make delete_folder and move_documents_to_folder fully atomic
message:
Make delete_folder and move_documents_to_folder fully atomic

Replace per-document savepoints with a single transaction.atomic() block
in both delete_folder() and move_documents_to_folder(). If any document
fails to relocate, the entire operation is rolled back — no partial state
is ever visible. This addresses the review concern about mixed state where
some documents end up relocated while others remain stuck.

Key changes:
- delete_folder: single atomic block, exception propagates to rollback all
- move_documents_to_folder: single atomic block with pre-computed paths
- Within-batch conflict detection: _disambiguate_path_with_batch() prevents
  two documents with the same filename from colliding during bulk moves
- _compute_moved_path: early guard for empty/whitespace/root-only paths
- Updated tests to verify full rollback (not partial success), retry safety,
  child reparenting rollback, and within-batch disambiguation
- CHANGELOG updated to document atomic guarantees

subject: Add backend flag with carryforward to .codecov.yml
message:
Add backend flag with carryforward to .codecov.yml

PR #1205 introduced Codecov coverage reporting for the frontend with
`carryforward: true` on the `frontend-unit` and `frontend-component`
flags, but never defined a `backend` flag. The backend workflow has
been uploading to `flags: backend` for a while, so Codecov knows about
the flag, but with no `carryforward` entry, any commit whose pytest
job fails or times out causes backend files to be reported at 0% for
that commit — which then replaces the healthy ~90% backend coverage on
the Codecov dashboard.

This is exactly what happened on commit b4bad65 (the merge of PR
#1213): the push-to-main pytest check failed, so no backend
`coverage.xml` was uploaded. As a result, the dashboard flipped from
the prior 50.66% (716 files, 3 sessions = backend + frontend-unit +
frontend-component) to 39.21% (488 files, 2 sessions, frontend only),
hiding backend coverage entirely.

Adding the `backend` flag with `carryforward: true` (scoped to
`opencontractserver/` and `config/`) makes the configuration
symmetrical with the frontend flags and ensures a flaky or failing
backend run inherits the previous commit's backend coverage instead
of zeroing it out.

been uploading to `flags: backend` for a while, so Codecov knows about
the flag, but with no `carryforward` entry, any commit whose pytest
job fails or times out causes backend files to be reported at 0% for
that commit — which then replaces the healthy ~90% backend coverage on
the Codecov dashboard.

This is exactly what happened on commit f166a59 (the merge of PR
#1213): the push-to-main pytest check failed, so no backend
`coverage.xml` was uploaded. As a result, the dashboard flipped from
the prior 50.66% (716 files, 3 sessions = backend + frontend-unit +
frontend-component) to 39.21% (488 files, 2 sessions, frontend only),
hiding backend coverage entirely.

Adding the `backend` flag with `carryforward: true` (scoped to
`opencontractserver/` and `config/`) makes the configuration
symmetrical with the frontend flags and ensures a flaky or failing
backend run inherits the previous commit's backend coverage instead
of zeroing it out.

subject: Cache target folder path in bulk move loop (fixes #1202)
message:
Cache target folder path in bulk move loop (fixes #1202)

DocumentFolderService.move_documents_to_folder() called _compute_moved_path()
once per document, and each invocation called target_folder.get_path() — which
walks ancestors via a recursive CTE query through tree_queries. For an
N-document bulk move to the same folder, that issued N redundant CTE round
trips for an O(1) value.

Resolve the target folder path once before the loop and thread it through
_compute_moved_path() via a new optional target_folder_path parameter. The
parameter defaults to None and is fully backwards compatible — existing
single-call sites (move_document_to_folder, delete_folder) and tests that
pass two positional args remain unchanged.
